contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Message SK Official on WhatsApp about products, sizes and orders. Pay by UPI or cash.
contact.lead: Questions about a product, a size or an order? Message us on WhatsApp and we will reply as soon as we can.

faq.a: Open a product, choose a design and tap Order on WhatsApp, or add several items to your bag and send them together. We reply on WhatsApp to confirm.
By UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or any UPI app) or in cash. We confirm the order before you pay.

faq.q: Why do some items say "from" or show several prices?
faq.a: Some items come in several designs at different prices. We confirm the exact price for your design on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I see more designs or photos?
faq.a: Yes. Message us and we will send photos of everything in stock.
